title: Record the FFT carry recovery
body:
## Summary
- The base-B carry `c_i + K_i = d_i + B K_{i+1}` rebuilds the integer product, and the worst-case update `(q(B-1)^2 + q(B-1))/B` equals `q(B-1)` exactly.
- All 1,398,096 products of width 2 through 10 recover on the published FFT geometry, with every carry inside the cap and a zero final carry.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
